description: Infrastructure parameters applied on top of the per-token IT energy. Each is a {low, mid, high} triple. Override any of them in the project config (.claude/pegada.config.json) with a number or a triple. See METHODOLOGY.md.

pue.source: low ≈ Google fleet-wide trailing PUE (~1.10, 2023 environmental report); high = Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2024 industry average (1.56); mid = hyperscale-typical value (AWS reported ~1.15 for 2023).
pue.notes: The serving provider and data centre are not disclosed; the range spans hyperscale to industry-average facilities.

grid_intensity.source: mid ≈ US grid average (EIA 2023: 0.81 lb CO2/kWh ≈ 367 g); low = low-carbon grids (hydro/nuclear-heavy regions); high = coal-heavy grids. Location-based, not market-based (renewable energy certificates are not accounted for).
grid_intensity.notes: The serving region is unknown (transcripts report inference_geo = not_available). Set this to your best knowledge of the serving region.

embodied.unit: gCO2e per kWh of IT energy
embodied.source: PLACEHOLDER: embodied emissions of an 8-GPU inference server (order of 3–10 tCO2e) amortised over its lifetime IT energy (4 years at ~6 kW and ~60% utilisation ≈ 125 MWh). Not measured, not for citation.
embodied.notes: Amortised per kWh of IT energy (i.e. before PUE). Facility/building embodied emissions are not included.
